name: @bina/dsh-goal-guard
description: The office's fence around the automatic goal round loop: a round that produced no tool call gets no next round, the office's round ceiling applies to every goal (a goal cannot raise it), and a round is refused when the turn's every step was empty. Born of the 2026-11-01 runaway: 783 of 961 rounds in one hour, ₪19.10 on one session.
